name: std::istreambuf_iterator<CharT,Traits>::operator*
intro:
Reads a single character by calling sbuf_->sgetc() where sbuf_ is the stored pointer to the stream buffer.

The behavior is undefined if the iterator is end-of-stream iterator.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The value of the obtained character.

summary: Reads a single character by calling sbuf_->sgetc() where sbuf_ is the stored pointer to the stream buffer.
